title: Signed approval of a new device
description: The object the approval key of an ACTIVE device signs (RFC 8785 canonical form) to activate a device that was just enrolled. Naming a kid proves nothing; this statement does, because it covers both thumbprints of the new device, the enrollment nonce and the pairing code the user compared on both phones.

new_kid.description: The new device's approval key id.

pairing_code.description: The six digit code both phones showed; defined in the spec, section 8.3.

nonce.description: The enrollment nonce of the new device.

issued_at.description: Unix time in seconds; accepted within 300 seconds of the server's clock.

thumbprint.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of an EC P-256 public JWK, base64url of the SHA-256.
